sources.citation: Rosa I, Ibba-Manneschi L, Guasti D, Perigli G, Faussone-Pellegrini MS, Manetti M (2022). Morphologic evidence of telocytes in human thyroid stromal tissue. Journal of Cellular and Molecular Medicine26:2477–2481.
sources.rights_basis: Primary XML copyright/licence and published PDF metadata inspected; no Figure1 third-party exception located.
sources.crop_operation: Full H&E PanelA exact integer crop of Pillow-decoded native2079×2101 embedded JPEG; no resampling/retouch/recolour/new leaders or bar. Other IHC/IF panels omitted.
source_marks_retained: Original complete black scale bar; numeric50µm assignment comes from source caption, not a printed bitmap glyph
sources.specimen: Human thyroid parenchyma without obvious lesion from surgical adult specimens; five adults in study; photographed donor identity/overall health/endocrine function not supplied.
sources.preparation: 5µm formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded section, routine haematoxylin/eosin staining. Immunostaining/epoxy-resin protocols in same article are not assigned to this H&E panel.
sources.source_caption_structure: Colloid-containing follicles lined by epithelial thyrocytes with interfollicular reticular connective tissue.
sources.source_calibration: Source Figure1 caption assigns50µm bar toA–D; onlyA reproduced. No new ruler or nominal magnification substituted.
boundaries: Two-dimensional prepared profiles, not spheres/full3D follicle sizes
Some follicular profiles cross image edges
H&E colours are stain appearance, not natural tissue colour

acquisition_vs_composition: Native PDF acquired and JPEG stream extracted separately; full figure/PDF remain private because other panels are unrelated. Public composer needs only immutableA PNG and source/proofJSON. No private/network dependency on rebuild.
decoder_caution: Original JPEG stream is byte-identical to PDF raw DCT stream. Pillow and MuPDF JPEG decoding differ; only the named Pillow-decoded crop proof is claimed, not cross-decoder RGB identity.
